bio:
Eliza Willett Nicoll was born in 1789, the daughter of Henry Nicoll and Elizabeth Woodhull, herself a daughter of General Nathaniel Woodhull. Through the Woodhulls she descended from Bull Smith of Smithtown: Bull Smith's son Richard Smith 2d was the father of Sarah Smith, who married Nathaniel Woodhull and was the mother of the General. That makes Eliza John's 4th cousin 7 times removed.

After Henry Nicoll's death her mother became the third wife of General John Smith, the United States Senator, who thus became Eliza's stepfather. Eliza married Richard Smith 5th, and their son was Judge J. Lawrence Smith. She died on 2 April 1865.
